install: set -euo pipefail; mkdir -p "$HOME/.local/bin" "$HOME/.local/opt" /tmp/install-tools; if [ ! -x "$HOME/.local/opt/godot/Godot_v4.7.2-stable_linux.x86_64" ]; then mkdir -p "$HOME/.local/opt/godot" && curl -fsSL "https://github.com/godotengine/godot/releases/download/4.7.2-stable/Godot_v4.7.2-stable_linux.x86_64.zip" -o /tmp/install-tools/godot.zip && python3 -m zipfile -e /tmp/install-tools/godot.zip "$HOME/.local/opt/godot/" && chmod +x "$HOME/.local/opt/godot/Godot_v4.7.2-stable_linux.x86_64"; fi; ln -sfn "$HOME/.local/opt/godot/Godot_v4.7.2-stable_linux.x86_64" "$HOME/.local/bin/godot"; if [ ! -x "$HOME/.local/opt/blender-5.3.0-linux-x64/blender" ]; then curl -fsSL "https://download.blender.org/release/Blender5.3/blender-5.3.0-linux-x64.tar.xz" -o /tmp/install-tools/blender.tar.xz && tar -xJf /tmp/install-tools/blender.tar.xz -C "$HOME/.local/opt/"; fi; ln -sfn "$HOME/.local/opt/blender-5.3.0-linux-x64/blender" "$HOME/.local/bin/blender"; rm -rf /tmp/install-tools; sed -i '/case \$- in/,/esac/d' "$HOME/.bashrc" 2>/dev/null || true; grep -qxF 'export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"' "$HOME/.bashrc" || echo 'export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"' >> "$HOME/.bashrc"
